| GET  /stats                | —                           | engine counters |\n//! | POST /tx/begin             | —                           | begin tx |\n//! | POST /tx/{id}/put          | {\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"v\"}     | buffer write |\n//! | POST /tx/{id}/delete       | {\"key\":\"k\"}                 | buffer delete |\n//! | POST /tx/{id}/get          | {\"key\":\"k\"}                 | read in tx |\n//! | POST /tx/{id}/commit       | —                           | commit (409 on conflict) |\n//! | POST /tx/{id}/abort        | —                           | abort |\n//! | POST /snapshot             | —                           | pin a snapshot |\n//! | POST /snapshot/{id}/get    | {\"key\":\"k\"}                 | read pinned snapshot |\n//! | POST /snapshot/{id}/release| —                           | release pin |\n//! | POST /gc                   | —                           | run reclamation |\n//! | GET  /admin/faults         | —                           | armed fault |\n//! | POST /admin/faults         | {\"op\":\"sync\",\"leave_written\":false} | arm one-shot fault |\n//! | POST /admin/faults/reset   | —                           | disarm |\n\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse crate::engine::{Engine, GcReport, Stats};\nuse crate::error::Error;\nuse crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::FaultOp;\n\npub struct Server {\n    engine: Engine,\n    addr: String,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(engine: Engine, addr: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        Server {\n            engine,\n            addr: addr.into(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Bind and serve forever (blocking).\n    pub fn serve(self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(&self.addr)?;\n        let engine = Arc::new(self.engine);\n        eprintln!(\"mvcc-gc listening on http://{}\", listener.local_addr()?);\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(s) => {\n                    let engine = engine.clone();\n                    thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = handle_conn(s, engine);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Route one request. Exposed for tests.\n    pub fn handle(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: &[u8]) -> (u16, Json) {\n        route(&self.engine, method, path, body)\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Routing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn route(engine: &Engine, method: &str, path: &str, body: &[u8]) -> (u16, Json) {\n    let result: crate::error::Result<Json> = (|| {\n        match (method, path) {\n            (\"GET\", \"/health\") => Ok(obj_with(\"status\", Json::string(\"ok\"))),\n            (\"GET\", \"/stats\") => Ok(stats_json(&engine.stats())),\n            (\"POST\", \"/tx/begin\") => {\n                let (id, read_version) = engine.begin();\n                let mut o = Json::obj();\n                o.insert(\"tx\", Json::uint(id));\n                o.insert(\"read_version\", Json::uint(read_version));\n                Ok(o)\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"/snapshot\") => {\n                let s = engine.snapshot();\n                let mut o = Json::obj();\n                o.insert(\"snapshot\", Json::uint(s.id));\n                o.insert(\"version\", Json::uint(s.version));\n                Ok(o)\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"/gc\") => Ok(gc_json(engine.gc()?)),\n            (\"GET\", \"/admin/faults\") => {\n                let mut o = Json::obj();\n                match engine.faults().armed() {\n                    Some(op) => o.insert(\"armed\", Json::string(op.as_str())),\n                    None => o.insert(\"armed\", Json::Null),\n                }\n                Ok(o)\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"/admin/faults\") => {\n                let j = parse_body(body)?;\n                let op = j\n                    .get(\"op\")\n                    .and_then(Json::as_str)\n                    .and_then(FaultOp::parse)\n                    .ok_or_else(|| {\n                        Error::BadRequest(\n                            \"op must be one of write|sync|rename|sync_parent|remove\".into(),\n                        )\n                    })?;\n                let leave = j.get(\"leave_written\").and_then(Json::as_bool).unwrap_or(false);\n                engine.faults().arm(op, leave);\n                let mut o = Json::obj();\n                o.insert(\"armed\", Json::string(op.as_str()));\n                o.insert(\"leave_written\", Json::Bool(leave));\n                Ok(o)\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"/admin/faults/reset\") => {\n                engine.faults().disarm();\n                Ok(obj_with(\"disarmed\", Json::Bool(true)))\n            }\n            _ => route_dynamic(engine, method, path, body),\n        }\n    })();\n\n    match result {\n        Ok(mut j) => {\n            j.insert(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true));\n            (200, j)\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            let status = match &e {\n                Error::NotFound | Error::UnknownTx(_) | Error::UnknownSnapshot(_) => 404,\n                Error::Conflict(_) => 409,\n                Error::BadRequest(_) => 400,\n                _ => 500,\n            };\n            let mut j = Json::obj();\n            j.insert(\"ok\", Json::Bool(false));\n            j.insert(\"error\", Json::string(e.to_string()));\n            (status, j)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn route_dynamic(\n    engine: &Engine,\n    method: &str,\n    path: &str,\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> crate::error::Result<Json> {\n    // /tx/{id}/{action}\n    if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix(\"/tx/\") {\n        let (id, action) = split_id(rest)?;\n        match (method, action) {\n            (\"POST\", \"put\") => {\n                let j = parse_body(body)?;\n                let key = body_key(&j)?;\n                let value = j\n                    .get(\"value\")\n                    .and_then(Json::as_str)\n                    .ok_or_else(|| Error::BadRequest(\"missing string field \\\"value\\\"\".into()))?;\n                engine.put(id, key.into_bytes(), value.as_bytes().to_vec())?;\n                return Ok(obj_with(\"buffered\", Json::Bool(true)));\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"delete\") => {\n                let j = parse_body(body)?;\n                engine.delete(id, body_key(&j)?.into_bytes())?;\n                return Ok(obj_with(\"buffered\", Json::Bool(true)));\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"get\") => {\n                let j = parse_body(body)?;\n                let key = body_key(&j)?;\n                return Ok(value_json(engine.get_tx(id, key.as_bytes())?, key));\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"commit\") => {\n                let version = engine.commit(id)?;\n                return Ok(obj_with(\"version\", Json::uint(version)));\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"abort\") => {\n                engine.abort(id)?;\n                return Ok(obj_with(\"aborted\", Json::Bool(true)));\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    // /snapshot/{id}/{action}\n    if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix(\"/snapshot/\") {\n        let (id, action) = split_id(rest)?;\n        match (method, action) {\n            (\"POST\", \"get\") => {\n                let j = parse_body(body)?;\n                let key = body_key(&j)?;\n                return Ok(value_json(engine.get_snapshot(id, key.as_bytes())?, key));\n            }\n            (\"POST\", \"release\") => {\n                engine.release_snapshot(id)?;\n                return Ok(obj_with(\"released\", Json::Bool(true)));\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    Err(Error::BadRequest(format!(\"no route for {method} {path}\")))\n}\n\nfn split_id(rest: &str) -> crate::error::Result<(u64, &str)> {\n    let (id_s, action) = rest\n Json::uint(s.keys as u64));\n    o.insert(\"live_cells\", Json::uint(s.live_cells as u64));\n    o.insert(\n        \"open_transactions\",\n        Json::Arr(\n            s.open_transactions\n                .iter()\n                .map(|(id, rv)| {\n                    let mut t = Json::obj();\n                    t.insert(\"tx\", Json::uint(*id));\n                    t.insert(\"read_version\", Json::uint(*rv));\n                    t\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        ),\n    );\n    o.insert(\n        \"snapshots\",\n        Json::Arr(\n            s.snapshots\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| {\n                    let mut t = Json::obj();\n                    t.insert(\"snapshot\", Json::uint(s.id));\n                    t.insert(\"version\", Json::uint(s.version));\n                    t\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        ),\n    );\n    let mut files = Json::obj();\n    files.insert(\"segments\", Json::uint(s.segment_files as u64));\n    files.insert(\"bases\", Json::uint(s.base_files as u64));\n    files.insert(\"stale\", Json::uint(s.stale_files as u64));\n    files.insert(\"live_bytes\", Json::uint(s.live_bytes));\n    files.insert(\"stale_bytes\", Json::uint(s.stale_bytes));\n    o.insert(\"files\", files);\n    o\n}\n\nfn gc_json(r: GcReport) -> Json {\n    let mut o = Json::obj();\n    o.insert(\"horizon\", Json::uint(r.horizon));\n    o.insert(\"base_version_before\", Json::uint(r.base_version_before));\n    o.insert(\"base_written\", Json::Bool(r.base_written));\n    o.insert(\"base_cells\", Json::uint(r.base_cells as u64));\n    o.insert(\"files_removed\", Json::uint(r.files_removed as u64));\n    o.insert(\"bytes_reclaimed\", Json::uint(r.bytes_reclaimed));\n    o.insert(\"stale_left\", Json::uint(r.stale_left as u64));\n    match r.noop_reason {\n        Some(reason) => o.insert(\"noop_reason\", Json::string(reason)),\n        None => o.insert(\"noop_reason\", Json::Null),\n    }\n    o\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// HTTP wire\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst MAX_HEAD: usize = 64 * 1024;\nconst MAX_BODY: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\nfn handle_conn(mut stream: TcpStream, find_subslice(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            break pos + 4;\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut chunk)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);\n        if buf.len() > MAX_HEAD {\n            return write_response(&mut stream, 431, b\"{\\\"ok\\\":false,\\\"error\\\":\\\"head too large\\\"}\");\n        }\n = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((name, value)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            if name.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = value.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if content_length > MAX_BODY {\n        return write_response(&mut stream, 413, b\"{\\\"ok\\\":false,\\\"error\\\":\\\"body too large\\\"}\");\n    }\n\n    // Read the rest of the body.\n    let mut body = buf.split_off(head_end);\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut chunk)?;\n        if format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\\r\\ncontent-type: application/json\\r\\ncontent-length: {}\\r\\nconnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        payload.len()\n    );\n Engine behaviour tests on the in-memory file system.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::error::Error;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::MemVfs;\n\nfn open() -> (Engine, MemVfs) {\n    let vfs = MemVfs::new();\n    let engine = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n    (engine, vfs)\n}\n\nfn b(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    s.as_bytes().to_vec()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn put_get_commit_and_versions_are_monotonic() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    let (t1, rv1) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv1, 0);\n    e.put(t1, b(\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"b\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.commit(t1).unwrap(), 1);\n\n    let (t2, rv2) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv2, 1);\n    e.put(t2, b(\"a\"), b(\"3\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.commit(t2).unwrap(), 2);\n\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"a\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"3\")));\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"b\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"2\")));\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"missing\").unwrap(), None);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn transaction_reads_its_own_writes_and_fixed_snapshot() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"k\"), b(\"v1\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    // Long transaction starts at v1.\n    let (reader, rv) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv, 1);\n\n    // Another transaction overwrites k.\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b(\"k\"), b(\"v2\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n\n    // The long transaction still sees v1.\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v1\")));\n\n    // Read-your-writes inside the long transaction.\n    e.put(reader, b(\"k\"), b(\"mine\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"mine\")));\n    e.abort(reader).unwrap();\n\n    // A fresh transaction sees v2.\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn write_write_conflict_rejects_second_commit() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t0, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t0, b(\"x\"), b(\"0\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t0).unwrap();\n\n    // Two writers race on the same key from the same snapshot.\n    let (a, _) = e.begin();\n    let (btx, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(a, b(\"x\"), b(\"A\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(btx, b(\"x\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n\n    e.commit(a).unwrap(); // first writer wins\n    match e.commit(btx) {\n        Err(Error::Conflict(k)) => assert_eq!(k, b(\"x\")),\n        other => panic!(\"expected conflict, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // The losing transaction is still open: abort it, retry as a new tx.\n    e.abort(btx).unwrap();\n    let (c, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(c, b(\"x\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(c).unwrap();\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"x\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"B\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn disjoint_writers_do_not_conflict() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (a, _) = e.begin();\n    let (btx, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(a, b(\"k1\"), b(\"A\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(btx, b(\"k2\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(a).unwrap();\n    e.commit(btx).unwrap(); // no shared keys: both commit\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn delete_removes_key_and_conflicts_like_a_write() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"d\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.delete(t2, b(\"d\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"d\").unwrap(), None);\n\n    // Delete of a never-existing key commits fine.\n    let (t4, _) = e.begin();\n    e.delete(t4, b(\"never\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t4).unwrap();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn abort_discards_buffered_writes() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    e.abort(t).unwrap();\n    assert!(matches!(e.commit(t), Err(Error::UnknownTx(_))));\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t2, b\"k\").unwrap(), None);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn explicit_snapshot_pins_a_version() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"s\"), b(\"old\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    let snap = e.snapshot();\n    assert_eq!(snap.version, 1);\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b(\"s\"), b(\"new\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n\n    assert_eq!(e.get_snapshot(snap.id, b\"s\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"old\")));\n    e.release_snapshot(snap.id).unwrap();\n    assert!(matches!(\n        e.get_snapshot(snap.id, b\"s\"),\n        Err(Error::UnknownSnapshot(_))\n    ));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_is_noop_without_progress() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(!report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.files_removed, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_compacts_and_reclaims_when_no_readers() {\n    let (e, vfs) = open();\n    for i in 0..5 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n    let before = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(before.segment_files, 5);\n    let bytes_before = vfs.bytes_under(&PathBuf::from(\"/data\")).1;\n\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.horizon, 5);\n    assert_eq!(report.files_removed, 5);\n    assert!(report.bytes_reclaimed > 0);\n\n    let after = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(after.segment_files, 0);\n    assert_eq!(after.base_files, 1);\n    let bytes_after = vfs.bytes_under(&PathBuf::from(\"/data\")).1;\n    assert!(\n        bytes_after < bytes_before,\n        \"expected reclamation: {bytes_before} -> {bytes_after}\"\n    );\n\n    // Data still readable at the latest version.\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v4\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_retains_versions_needed_by_long_reader() {\n    let (e, vfs) = open();\n    // v1: k=old\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"k\"), b(\"old\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let snap = e.snapshot();\n    assert_eq!(snap.version, 1);\n\n    // v2..=v4 overwrite k.\n    for i in 2..=4u32 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // GC while the reader is pinned: horizon stays at 1.\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.horizon, 1);\n    // seg-1 is folded into the base; newer segments must survive.\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.base_files, 1);\n    assert_eq!(stats.segment_files, 3, \"segments 2..4 must be retained\");\n\n    // The pinned reader still reads the old value.\n    assert_eq!(e.get_snapshot(snap.id, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"old\")));\n\n    // Release the pin: the next GC compacts everything.\n    e.release_snapshot(snap.id).unwrap();\n    let report2 = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report2.horizon, 4);\n    let stats2 = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats2.segment_files, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats2.base_files, 1);\n\n    // Space actually reclaimed relative to the pinned state.\n    let bytes_now = vfs.bytes_under(&PathBuf::from(\"/data\")).1;\n    assert!(bytes_now > 0);\n\n    // Latest value still correct.\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v4\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_recovers_committed_state() {\n    let vfs = MemVfs::new();\n    {\n        let e = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"persist\"), b(\"yes\")).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n        let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t2, b(\"gone\"), b(\"uncommitted\")).unwrap();\n        e.abort(t2).unwrap();\n    } // engine dropped: LOCK released\n\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 1);\n    let (t, _) = e2.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e2.get_tx(t, b\"persist\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"yes\")));\n    assert_eq!(e2.get_tx(t, b\"gone\").unwrap(), None);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_after_gc_reads_from_base() {\n    let vfs = MemVfs::new();\n    {\n        let e = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n        for i in 0..3 {\n            let (t, _) = e.begin();\n            e.put(t, b(\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n            e.commit(t).unwrap();\n        }\n        e.gc().unwrap();\n    }\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 3);\n    let (t, _) = e2.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e2.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n    // And new commits keep working on top of the base.\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v3\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.commit(t).unwrap(), 4);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn lock_prevents_double_open() {\n    let vfs = MemVfs::new();\n    let e = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n    let second = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone()));\n    assert!(second.is_err(), \"second open must fail while LOCK is held\");\n    drop(e);\n    let s.as_bytes().to_vec()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn put_get_commit_and_versions_are_monotonic() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    let (t1, rv1) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv1, 0);\n    e.put(t1, b(\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"b\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.commit(t1).unwrap(), 1);\n\n    let (t2, rv2) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv2, 1);\n    e.put(t2, b(\"a\"), b(\"3\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.commit(t2).unwrap(), 2);\n\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"a\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"3\")));\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"b\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"2\")));\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"missing\").unwrap(), None);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn transaction_reads_its_own_writes_and_fixed_snapshot() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"k\"), b(\"v1\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    // Long transaction starts at v1.\n    let (reader, rv) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv, 1);\n\n    // Another transaction overwrites k.\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b(\"k\"), b(\"v2\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n\n    // The long transaction still sees v1.\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v1\")));\n\n    // Read-your-writes inside the long transaction.\n    e.put(reader, b(\"k\"), b(\"mine\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"mine\")));\n    e.abort(reader).unwrap();\n\n    // A fresh transaction sees v2.\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn write_write_conflict_rejects_second_commit() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t0, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t0, b(\"x\"), b(\"0\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t0).unwrap();\n\n    // Two writers race on the same key from the same snapshot.\n    let (a, _) = e.begin();\n    let (btx, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(a, b(\"x\"), b(\"A\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(btx, b(\"x\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n\n    e.commit(a).unwrap(); // first writer wins\n    match e.commit(btx) {\n        Err(Error::Conflict(k)) => assert_eq!(k, b(\"x\")),\n        other => panic!(\"expected conflict, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // The losing transaction is still open: abort it, retry as a new tx.\n    e.abort(btx).unwrap();\n    let (c, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(c, b(\"x\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(c).unwrap();\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"x\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"B\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn disjoint_writers_do_not_conflict() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (a, _) = e.begin();\n    let (btx, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(a, b(\"k1\"), b(\"A\")).unwrap();\n    e.put(btx, b(\"k2\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(a).unwrap();\n    e.commit(btx).unwrap(); // no shared keys: both commit\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn delete_removes_key_and_conflicts_like_a_write() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"d\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.delete(t2, b(\"d\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n\n    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"d\").unwrap(), abort_discards_buffered_writes() {\n    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    e.abort(t).unwrap();\n    assert!(matches!(e.commit(t), assert_eq!(after.base_files, 1);\n    let bytes_after = vfs.bytes_under(&PathBuf::from(\"/data\")).1;\n    assert!(\n        bytes_after < bytes_before,\n        \"expected reclamation: {bytes_before} -> {bytes_after}\"\n    );\n\n    // Data still readable at the latest version.\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v4\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_retains_versions_needed_by_long_reader() {\n    let (e, vfs) = open();\n    // v1: k=old\n    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t1, b(\"k\"), b(\"old\")).unwrap();\n    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n\n    // Long reader pins v1.\n    let snap = e.snapshot();\n    assert_eq!(snap.version, 1);\n\n    // v2..=v4 overwrite k.\n    for i in 2..=4u32 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // GC while the reader is pinned: horizon stays at 1.\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.horizon, 1);\n    // seg-1 is folded into the base; newer segments must survive.\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.base_files, 1);\n Some(b(\"old\")));\n\n    // Release the pin: the next GC compacts everything.\n    e.release_snapshot(snap.id).unwrap();\n    let report2 = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report2.horizon, 4);\n Fault-injection and crash-boundary tests using [`FaultVfs`] over the\n//! in-memory file system.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::error::Error;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::{FaultOp, FaultVfs, MemVfs};\n\nfn open_faulty() -> (Engine, FaultVfs) {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem));\n    let engine = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    (engine, fault)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_sync_failure_leaves_tx_open_and_retry_succeeds() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // make the commit's fsync barrier fail\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    match e.commit(t) {\n        Err(Error::Injected(_)) | Err(Error::Io(_)) => {}\n        other => panic!(\"expected injected failure, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // No version was published.\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Transaction is still usable: retry the commit without a fault.\n    let v = e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v, 1);\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 1);\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t2, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_rename_failure_does_not_publish_version() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Rename, false); // file never reaches its final name\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Nothing to recover after a \"crash\": temp debris is cleaned and there\n    // is no segment to replay.\n    drop(e);\n    let mem2 = MemVfs::new_shared_from(&fault); // see helper below\n    let _ = mem2;\n    // (covered concretely by reopen test with a real shared MemVfs)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_fault_is_one_shot() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert!(fault.armed().is_none(), \"fault must self-disarm after firing\");\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b\"a\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e.commit(t2).is_ok());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_remove_failure_leaves_stale_file_retried_next_pass() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    for i in 0..3 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // Fail the first unlink of the first GC pass.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Remove, false);\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.stale_left, 1, \"one obsolete file failed to unlink\");\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.stale_files, 1);\n\n    // Next pass retries and removes the stale file.\n    let report2 = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(!report2.base_written, \"no newer horizon to compact\");\n    let stats2 = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats2.stale_files, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn interrupted_gc_before_base_publish_changes_nothing() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    for i in 0..3 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // GC fails while fsyncing the new base temp file: no base, no deletes.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    assert!(e.gc().is_err());\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.base_version, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats.segment_files, 3, \"nothing may be deleted before the base is durable\");\n\n    // Disarm and rerun: normal compaction.\n    fault.disarm();\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.files_removed, 3);\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_cleans_temp_debris_after_crash() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem.clone()));\n    let e = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // Crash the commit right after the data hit the temp file.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Write, true);\n    let _ = e.commit(t);\n\n    // A temp file exists; no committed version.\n    let paths = mem.list_paths();\n    assert!(paths.iter().any(|p| {\n        p.file_name()\n            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().starts_with('.') && n.to_string_lossy().ends_with(\".tmp\"))\n            .unwrap_or(false)\n    }));\n\n    drop(e);\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(mem.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 0);\n    let names: Vec<String> = mem\n        .list_paths()\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.ends_with(\".tmp\")));\n}\n\n// helper extension: fault wraps its inner vfs privately, so tests that need\n// raw inspection keep their own clone of the backing MemVfs (see callers).\ntrait SharedFromFault {\n    fn new_shared_from(_f: &FaultVfs) -> Self {\n        unimplemented!(\"not used; kept out of the public surface\")\n    }\n}\nimpl SharedFromFault for MemVfs commit_sync_failure_leaves_tx_open_and_retry_succeeds() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), Fault-injection and crash-boundary tests using [`FaultVfs`] over the\n//! in-memory file system.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::error::Error;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::{FaultOp, FaultVfs, MemVfs};\n\nfn open_faulty() -> (Engine, FaultVfs) {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem));\n    let engine = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    (engine, fault)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_sync_failure_leaves_tx_open_and_retry_succeeds() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // make the commit's fsync barrier fail\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    match e.commit(t) {\n        Err(Error::Injected(_)) | Err(Error::Io(_)) => {}\n        other => panic!(\"expected injected failure, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // No version was published.\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Transaction is still usable: retry the commit without a fault.\n    let v = e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v, 1);\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 1);\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t2, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_rename_failure_does_not_publish_version() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Rename, false); // file never reaches its final name\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Nothing to recover after a \"crash\": temp debris is cleaned and there\n    // is no segment to replay.\n    drop(e);\n    let mem2 = MemVfs::new_shared_from(&fault); // see helper below\n    let _ = mem2;\n    // (covered concretely by reopen test with a real shared MemVfs)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_fault_is_one_shot() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert!(fault.armed().is_none(), \"fault must self-disarm after firing\");\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b\"a\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e.commit(t2).is_ok());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_remove_failure_leaves_stale_file_retried_next_pass() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    for i in 0..3 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // Fail the first unlink of the first GC pass.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Remove, false);\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.stale_left, 1, \"one obsolete file failed to unlink\");\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.stale_files, 1);\n\n    // Next pass retries and removes the stale file.\n    let report2 = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(!report2.base_written, \"no newer horizon to compact\");\n    let stats2 = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats2.stale_files, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn interrupted_gc_before_base_publish_changes_nothing() {\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty();\n    for i in 0..3 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b\"k\"), &format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // GC fails while fsyncing the new base temp file: no base, no deletes.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    assert!(e.gc().is_err());\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.base_version, 0);\n    assert_eq!(stats.segment_files, 3, \"nothing may be deleted before the base is durable\");\n\n    // Disarm and rerun: normal compaction.\n    fault.disarm();\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.files_removed, 3);\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_cleans_temp_debris_after_crash() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem.clone()));\n    let e = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // Crash the commit right after the data hit the temp file.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Write, true);\n    let _ = e.commit(t);\n\n    // A temp file exists; no committed version.\n    let paths = mem.list_paths();\n    assert!(paths.iter().any(|p| {\n        p.file_name()\n            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().starts_with('.') && n.to_string_lossy().ends_with(\".tmp\"))\n            .unwrap_or(false)\n    }));\n\n    drop(e);\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(mem.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 0);\n    let names: Vec<String> = mem\n        .list_paths()\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.ends_with(\".tmp\")));\n}\n\n// helper extension: fault wraps its inner vfs privately, so tests that need\n// raw inspection keep their own clone of the backing MemVfs (see callers).\ntrait SharedFromFault {\n    fn new_shared_from(_f: &FaultVfs) -> Self {\n        unimplemented!(\"not used; kept out of the public surface\")\n    }\n}\nimpl SharedFromFault for MemVfs Fault-injection and crash-boundary tests using [`FaultVfs`] over the\n//! in-memory file system.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::error::Error;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::{FaultOp, FaultVfs, MemVfs};\n\nfn b(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    s.as_bytes().to_vec()\n}\n\nfn open_faulty(mem: &MemVfs) -> (Engine, FaultVfs) {\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem.clone()));\n    let engine = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    (engine, fault)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_sync_failure_leaves_tx_open_and_retry_succeeds() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // Make the commit's fsync barrier fail.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    match e.commit(t) {\n        Err(Error::Injected(_)) | Err(Error::Io(_)) => {}\n        other => panic!(\"expected injected failure, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // No version was published.\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Transaction is still usable: retry the commit without a fault.\n    let v = e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(v, 1);\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 1);\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t2, b(\"k\")).unwrap(), Some(b(\"v\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn commit_rename_failure_does_not_publish_version_or_file() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Rename, false); // file never reaches its final name\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n\n    // Simulate a restart: only temp debris is present and is cleaned up;\n    // there is no committed segment to replay.\n    drop(e);\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(mem.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 0);\n    let (t2, _) = e2.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e2.get_tx(t2, b(\"k\")).unwrap(), None);\n    let names: Vec<String> = mem\n        .list_paths()\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.ends_with(\".tmp\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_fault_is_one_shot() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e.commit(t).is_err());\n    assert!(fault.armed().is_none(), \"fault must self-disarm after firing\");\n\n    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t2, b(\"a\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n    assert!(e2_ok(&e));\n}\n\nfn e2_ok(e: &Engine) -> bool {\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"a\"), b(\"2\")).is_ok() && e.commit(t).is_ok()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_remove_failure_leaves_stale_file_retried_next_pass() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n    for i in 0..3u32 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"k\"), format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // Fail one unlink during the first GC pass.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Remove, false);\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.stale_left, 1, \"one obsolete file failed to unlink\");\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.stale_files, 1);\n\n    // Next pass has no newer horizon but retries the stale unlink.\n    let report2 = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(!report2.base_written, \"no newer horizon to compact\");\n    let stats2 = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats2.stale_files, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn interrupted_gc_before_base_publish_deletes_nothing() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let (e, fault) = open_faulty(&mem);\n    for i in 0..3u32 {\n        let (t, _) = e.begin();\n        e.put(t, b(\"k\"), format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        e.commit(t).unwrap();\n    }\n\n    // GC fails while fsyncing the new base temp file: no base, no deletes.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Sync, false);\n    assert!(e.gc().is_err());\n\n    let stats = e.stats();\n    assert_eq!(stats.base_version, 0);\n    assert_eq!(\n        stats.segment_files,\n        3,\n        \"nothing may be deleted before the base is durable\"\n    );\n\n    // Disarm and rerun: normal compaction.\n    fault.disarm();\n    let report = e.gc().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.base_written);\n    assert_eq!(report.files_removed, 3);\n\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t, b(\"k\")).unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_cleans_temp_debris_after_crash() {\n    let mem = MemVfs::new();\n    let fault = FaultVfs::new(Arc::new(mem.clone()));\n    let e = Engine::open_faulted(\"/data\", fault.clone()).unwrap();\n    let (t, _) = e.begin();\n    e.put(t, b(\"k\"), b(\"v\")).unwrap();\n    // Crash the commit mid-write, after a prefix of the temp file landed.\n    fault.arm(FaultOp::Write, true);\n    let _ = e.commit(t);\n\n    assert!(\n        mem.list_paths().iter().any(|p| p\n            .file_name()\n            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().starts_with('.')\n                && n.to_string_lossy().ends_with(\".tmp\"))\n            .unwrap_or(false)),\n        \"a torn temp file should be present after the crash\"\n    );\n\n    drop(e);\n    let e2 = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(mem.clone())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(e2.current_version(), 0);\n    let names: Vec<String> = mem\n        .list_paths()\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.ends_with(\".tmp\")));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":77,"oldLines":16,"newStart":77,"newLines":12,"lines":[" {"parentUuid":"3ee62180-eee9-4f15-9a94-ea03f05a15fc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6e75a142f1db4f1197a07429","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/b/tests/http_scenario.rs","content":"//! Acceptance scenario, driven deterministically through the HTTP router\n//! (no sockets): two writers and one long reader are interleaved by the\n//! test itself, which acts as the controlled scheduler.\n//!\n//! Verified:\n//!  1. read consistency — the long reader always observes its pinned\n//!     snapshot while writers commit around it;\n//!  2. conflict outcome — the second writer touching the same key is\n//!     rejected with HTTP 409, then succeeds after re-basing;\n//!  3. reclamation — GC cannot reclaim while the snapshot is pinned, and\n//!     reclaims space once the snapshot is released.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::json::Json;\nuse mvcc_gc::server::Server;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::MemVfs;\n\nstruct Client {\n    server: Server,\n}\n\nimpl Client {\n    fn new() -> Self {\n        let engine = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(MemVfs::new())).unwrap();\n        Client {\n            server: Server::new(engine, \"test\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn call(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<Json>) -> (u16, Json) {\n        let bytes = body.map(|j| j.to_bytes()).unwrap_or_default();\n        self.server.handle(method, path, &bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn begin(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/tx/begin\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"tx\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"read_version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn put(&self, tx: u64, key: &str, value: &str) {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        body.insert(\"value\", Json::string(value));\n        let (s, _) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/put\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n    }\n\n    fn commit(&self, tx: u64) -> (u16, Json) {\n        self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/commit\"), None)\n    }\n\n    fn get_tx(&self, tx: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/snapshot\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"snapshot\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn get_snapshot(&self, snap: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/snapshot/{snap}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn stats(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n\n    fn gc(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/gc\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n}\n\nfn live_bytes(stats: &Json) -> u64 {\n    stats\n        .get(\"files\")\n        .unwrap()\n        .get(\"live_bytes\")\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_u64()\n        .unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn acceptance_two_writers_one_long_reader() {\n    let c = Client::new();\n\n    // --- setup: k=base at v1 -------------------------------------------\n    let (t0, _) = c.begin();\n    c.put(t0, \"k\", \"base\");\n    let (s, j) = c.commit(t0);\n    assert_eq!(s, 200);\n    assert_eq!(j.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 1);\n\n    // --- long reader pins v1 -------------------------------------------\n    let (snap, snap_v) = c.snapshot();\n    assert_eq!(snap_v, 1);\n\n    // --- two writers interleave on the same key -------------------------\n    let (wa, _) = c.begin(); // writer A @ v1\n    let (wb, _) = c.begin(); // writer B @ v1\n    c.put(wa, \"k\", \"A\");\n    c.put(wb, \"k\", \"B\");\n\n    // Controlled interleaving: A commits first and wins.\n    let (sa, ja) = c.commit(wa);\n    assert_eq!(sa, 200);\n    assert_eq!(ja.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 2);\n\n    // B conflicts: HTTP 409.\n    let (sb, jb) = c.commit(wb);\n    assert_eq!(sb, 409, \"writer B must be rejected: {jb:?}\");\n    assert_eq!(jb.get(\"ok\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap(), false);\n\n    // B re-bases and retries: commits at v3.\n    let (wb2, rv) = c.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv, 2);\n    c.put(wb2, \"k\", \"B\");\n    let (sb2, jb2) = c.commit(wb2);\n    assert_eq!(sb2, 200);\n    assert_eq!(jb2.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 3);\n\n    // --- read consistency under the pinned snapshot ---------------------\n    assert_eq!(c.get_snapshot(snap, \"k\").as_deref(), Some(\"base\"));\n    let (tnow, _) = c.begin();\n    assert_eq!(c.get_tx(tnow, \"k\").as_deref(), Some(\"B\"));\n\n    // --- GC while the snapshot is pinned --------------------------------\n    let bytes_pinned_before = live_bytes(&c.stats());\n    let g1 = c.gc();\n    assert_eq!(g1.get(\"horizon\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 1);\n    // The pinned snapshot still reads the old value after GC.\n    assert_eq!(c.get_snapshot(snap, \"k\").as_deref(), {"parentUuid":"283d1187-8319-4fa2-9c9c-1de1fbd15708","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/b/tests/engine_tests.rs","snippet":"1\t//! Engine behaviour tests on the in-memory file system.\n2\t\n3\tuse std::path::PathBuf;\n4\tuse std::sync::Arc;\n5\t\n6\tuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\n7\tuse mvcc_gc::error::Error;\n8\tuse mvcc_gc::vfs::MemVfs;\n9\t\n10\tfn open() -> (Engine, MemVfs) {\n11\t    let vfs = MemVfs::new();\n12\t    let engine = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(vfs.clone())).unwrap();\n13\t    (engine, vfs)\n14\t}\n15\t\n16\tfn b(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n17\t    s.as_bytes().to_vec()\n18\t}\n19\t\n20\t#[test]\n21\tfn put_get_commit_and_versions_are_monotonic() {\n22\t    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n23\t    assert_eq!(e.current_version(), 0);\n24\t\n25\t    let (t1, rv1) = e.begin();\n26\t    assert_eq!(rv1, 0);\n27\t    e.put(t1, b(\"a\"), b(\"1\")).unwrap();\n28\t    e.put(t1, b(\"b\"), b(\"2\")).unwrap();\n29\t    assert_eq!(e.commit(t1).unwrap(), 1);\n30\t\n31\t    let (t2, rv2) = e.begin();\n32\t    assert_eq!(rv2, 1);\n33\t    e.put(t2, b(\"a\"), b(\"3\")).unwrap();\n34\t    assert_eq!(e.commit(t2).unwrap(), 2);\n35\t\n36\t    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n37\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"a\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"3\")));\n38\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"b\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"2\")));\n39\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"missing\").unwrap(), None);\n40\t}\n41\t\n42\t#[test]\n43\tfn transaction_reads_its_own_writes_and_fixed_snapshot() {\n44\t    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n45\t    let (t1, _) = e.begin();\n46\t    e.put(t1, b(\"k\"), b(\"v1\")).unwrap();\n47\t    e.commit(t1).unwrap();\n48\t\n49\t    // Long transaction starts at v1.\n50\t    let (reader, rv) = e.begin();\n51\t    assert_eq!(rv, 1);\n52\t\n53\t    // Another transaction overwrites k.\n54\t    let (t2, _) = e.begin();\n55\t    e.put(t2, b(\"k\"), b(\"v2\")).unwrap();\n56\t    e.commit(t2).unwrap();\n57\t\n58\t    // The long transaction still sees v1.\n59\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v1\")));\n60\t\n61\t    // Read-your-writes inside the long transaction.\n62\t    e.put(reader, b(\"k\"), b(\"mine\")).unwrap();\n63\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(reader, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"mine\")));\n64\t    e.abort(reader).unwrap();\n65\t\n66\t    // A fresh transaction sees v2.\n67\t    let (t3, _) = e.begin();\n68\t    assert_eq!(e.get_tx(t3, b\"k\").unwrap(), Some(b(\"v2\")));\n69\t}\n70\t\n71\t#[test]\n72\tfn write_write_conflict_rejects_second_commit() {\n73\t    let (e, _vfs) = open();\n74\t    let (t0, _) = e.begin();\n75\t    e.put(t0, b(\"x\"), b(\"0\")).unwrap();\n76\t    e.commit(t0).unwrap();\n77\t\n78\t    // Two writers race on the same key from the same snapshot.\n79\t    let (a, _) = e.begin();\n80\t    let (btx, _) = e.begin();\n81\t    e.put(a, b(\"x\"), b(\"A\")).unwrap();\n82\t    e.put(btx, b(\"x\"), b(\"B\")).unwrap();\n83\t\n84\t    e.commit(a).unwrap(); // first writer wins\n85\t    match e.commit(btx) {\n86\t        Err(Error::Conflict(k)) => released.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::json::Json;\nuse mvcc_gc::server::Server;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::MemVfs;\n\nstruct Client {\n    server: Server,\n}\n\nimpl Client {\n    fn new() -> Self {\n        let engine = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(MemVfs::new())).unwrap();\n        Client {\n            server: Server::new(engine, \"test\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn call(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<Json>) -> (u16, Json) {\n        let bytes = body.map(|j| j.to_bytes()).unwrap_or_default();\n        self.server.handle(method, path, &bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn begin(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/tx/begin\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"tx\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"read_version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn put(&self, tx: u64, key: &str, value: &str) {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        body.insert(\"value\", Json::string(value));\n        let (s, _) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/put\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n    }\n\n    fn commit(&self, tx: u64) -> (u16, Json) {\n        self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/commit\"), None)\n    }\n\n    fn get_tx(&self, tx: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/snapshot\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"snapshot\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn get_snapshot(&self, snap: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/snapshot/{snap}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn stats(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n\n    fn gc(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/gc\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n}\n\nfn live_bytes(stats: &Json) -> u64 {\n    stats\n        .get(\"files\")\n        .unwrap()\n assert_eq!(snap_v, 1);\n\n    // --- two writers interleave on the same key -------------------------\n    let (wa, _) = c.begin(); // writer A @ v1\n    let (wb, _) = c.begin(); // writer B @ v1\n    c.put(wa, \"k\", \"A\");\n    c.put(wb, \"k\", \"B\");\n\n    // Controlled interleaving: A commits first and wins.\n    let (sa, ja) = c.commit(wa);\n    assert_eq!(sa, 200);\n    assert_eq!(ja.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 2);\n\n    // B conflicts: HTTP 409.\n    let (sb, jb) = c.commit(wb);\n    assert_eq!(sb, 409, \"writer B must be rejected: {jb:?}\");\n    assert_eq!(jb.get(\"ok\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap(), false);\n\n    // B re-bases and retries: commits at v3.\n    let (wb2, rv) = c.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv, 2);\n    c.put(wb2, \"k\", \"B\");\n Acceptance scenario, driven deterministically through the HTTP router\n//! (no sockets): two writers and one long reader are interleaved by the\n//! test itself, which acts as the controlled scheduler.\n//!\n//! is\n//!     rejected with HTTP 409, then succeeds after re-basing;\n//!  3. reclamation — GC cannot reclaim while the snapshot is pinned, and\n//!     reclaims space once the snapshot is released.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse mvcc_gc::engine::Engine;\nuse mvcc_gc::json::Json;\nuse mvcc_gc::server::Server;\nuse mvcc_gc::vfs::MemVfs;\n\nstruct Client {\n    server: Server,\n}\n\nimpl Client {\n    fn new() -> Self {\n        let engine = Engine::open(\"/data\", Arc::new(MemVfs::new())).unwrap();\n        Client {\n            server: Server::new(engine, \"test\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn call(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<Json>) -> (u16, Json) {\n        let bytes = body.map(|j| j.to_bytes()).unwrap_or_default();\n        self.server.handle(method, path, &bytes)\n    }\n\n    fn begin(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/tx/begin\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"tx\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"read_version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn put(&self, tx: u64, key: &str, value: &str) {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        body.insert(\"value\", Json::string(value));\n        let (s, _) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/put\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n    }\n\n    fn commit(&self, tx: u64) -> (u16, Json) {\n        self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/commit\"), None)\n    }\n\n    fn get_tx(&self, tx: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tx}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> (u64, u64) {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/snapshot\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        (\n            j.get(\"snapshot\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n            j.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn get_snapshot(&self, snap: u64, key: &str) -> Option<String> {\n        let mut body = Json::obj();\n        body.insert(\"key\", Json::string(key));\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/snapshot/{snap}/get\"), Some(body));\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        if j.get(\"found\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap() {\n            Some(j.get(\"value\").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_string())\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn stats(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n\n    fn gc(&self) -> Json {\n        let (s, j) = self.call(\"POST\", \"/gc\", None);\n        assert_eq!(s, 200);\n        j\n    }\n}\n\nfn live_bytes(stats: &Json) -> u64 {\n    stats\n        .get(\"files\")\n        .unwrap()\n        .get(\"live_bytes\")\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_u64()\n        .unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn acceptance_two_writers_one_long_reader() {\n    let c = Client::new();\n\n    // --- setup: k=base at v1 -------------------------------------------\n    let (t0, _) = c.begin();\n    c.put(t0, \"k\", \"base\");\n    let (s, j) = c.commit(t0);\n    assert_eq!(s, 200);\n    assert_eq!(j.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 1);\n\n    // --- long reader pins v1 -------------------------------------------\n    let (snap, snap_v) = c.snapshot();\n    assert_eq!(snap_v, 1);\n\n    // --- two writers interleave on the same key -------------------------\n    let (wa, _) = c.begin(); // writer A @ v1\n    let (wb, _) = c.begin(); // writer B @ v1\n    c.put(wa, \"k\", \"A\");\n    c.put(wb, \"k\", \"B\");\n\n    // Controlled interleaving: A commits first and wins.\n    let (sa, ja) = c.commit(wa);\n    assert_eq!(sa, 200);\n    assert_eq!(ja.get(\"version\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 2);\n\n    // B conflicts: HTTP 409.\n    let (sb, jb) = c.commit(wb);\n    assert_eq!(sb, 409, \"writer B must be rejected: {jb:?}\");\n    assert_eq!(jb.get(\"ok\").unwrap().as_bool().unwrap(), false);\n\n    // B re-bases and retries: commits at v3.\n    let (wb2, rv) = c.begin();\n    assert_eq!(rv, 2);\n    c.put(wb2, \"k\", \"B\");\n ---------------------\n    assert_eq!(c.get_snapshot(snap, \"k\").as_deref(), Some(\"base\"));\n    let (tnow, _) = c.begin();\n    assert_eq!(c.get_tx(tnow, \"k\").as_deref(), Some(\"B\"));\n    // An open transaction also pins its read version; close it so only the\n    // explicit snapshot keeps the horizon back.\n    let (s, _) = c.call(\"POST\", &format!(\"/tx/{tnow}/abort\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(s, 200);\n\n    // --- GC while the snapshot is pinned --------------------------------\n    let bytes_pinned_before = live_bytes(&c.stats());\n    let g1 = c.gc();\n    assert_eq!(g1.get(\"horizon\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap(), 1);\n    // The pinned snapshot still reads the old value after GC.\n    assert_eq!(c.get_snapshot(snap, \"k\").as_deref(), bash\n# End-to-end acceptance walkthrough against a real running server over TCP.\n#\n# Deterministically interleaves two writers with a long-lived reader and\n# demonstrates: fixed-snapshot read consistency, write-write conflict\n# (HTTP 409), GC retaining versions while a snapshot is pinned, and space\n# reclamation after the snapshot is released.\n#\n# Usage: ./scripts/acceptance.sh [addr]\nset -u\n\nADDR=\"${1:-127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nBASE=\"http://$ADDR\"\nJQ=\"$(command -v jq || true)\"\n\nsay()  { printf '\\n=== %s ===\\n' \"$*\"; }\nreq()  { # method path [json-body]\n  if [ -n \"${3:-}\" ]; then\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d \"$3\" -w '\\n__status__%{http_code}'\n  else\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" -w '\\n__status__%{http_code}'\n  fi\n}\ncall() { # prints: pretty json, sets STATUS\n  local out\n  out=\"$(req \"$@\")\"\n  STATUS=\"${out##*__status__}\"\n  out=\"${out%__status__*}\"\n  if [ -n \"$JQ\" ]; then printf '%s' \"$out\" | jq . 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\\n' \"$out\"; else printf '%s\\n' \"$out\"; fi\n  printf '(http %s)\\n' \"$STATUS\"\n}\n\nsay \"health\"\ncall GET /health\n\nsay \"initial stats\"\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"writer 0: PUT k=base -> commit v1\"\nTX0=$(call POST /tx/begin | tee /dev/stderr | $JQ -r .tx 2>/dev/null || true)\n# (parsed again below in a jq-independent way)\nTX0=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$TX0/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"base\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$TX0/commit\"\n\nsay \"long reader: pin a snapshot at v1\"\nSNAP_OUT=\"$(req POST /snapshot)\"\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$SNAP_OUT\" | \"${JQ:-cat}\" 2>/dev/null || true\nSNAP=\"$(printf '%s' \"$SNAP_OUT\" | sed 's/.*\"snapshot\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\n\nsay \"writers A and B both open at v1 and write k\"\nWA=\"$(req POST /tx/begin  | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\nWB=\"$(req POST /tx/begin  | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WA/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"A\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}'\n\nsay \"A commits first -> v2\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WA/commit\"\n\nsay \"B commits -> expected 409 conflict\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB/commit\"\n\nsay \"abort loser B, retry from a fresh snapshot -> v3\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB/abort\"\nWB2=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB2/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB2/commit\"\n\nsay \"pinned snapshot still reads base; latest reads B\"\ncall POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\nT=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/abort\"\n\nsay \"GC while pinned: horizon stays 1, segments 2,3 retained\"\ncall GET /stats\ncall POST /gc\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"release snapshot\"\ncall POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/release\"\n\nsay \"GC after release: everything compacts to one base, bytes reclaimed\"\ncall POST /gc\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"latest value after reclamation\"\nT=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/abort\"\n\nsay \"fault injection: arm an fsync failure, observe commit rejected, retry\"\ncall POST /admin/faults '{\"op\":\"sync\",\"leave_written\":false}'\nT=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/put\" '{\"key\":\"f\",\"value\":\"1\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/commit\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/commit\"\ncall GET /stats\n\necho\necho \"acceptance walkthrough }\nraw()  { # method path [json-body]\n  if [ -n \"${3:-}\" ]; then\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d \"$3\"\n  else\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\"\n  fi\n}\nnum()  { # extract integer field $1 from stdin (no jq dependency)\n  sed \"s/.*\\\"$1\\\":\\([0-9][0-9]*\\).*/\\1/\"\n}\ncall() { # method path [json-body]  -> prints body\n  local out\n  out=\"$(raw \"$@\")\"\n  printf '%s\\n' \"$out\"\n}\nbegin()  { raw POST /tx/begin | num tx; }\ncheck() { # label expected_substring actual\n  case \"$3\" in\n    *\"$2\"*) ;;\n    *) echo \"ASSERT FAILED: $1 (expected to contain: $2)\"; return 1 ;;\n  esac\n  echo \"ok: $1\"\n}\n\nsay \"health\"\ncall GET /health\n\nsay \"writer 0: PUT k=base -> commit v1\"\nTX0=\"$(begin)\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$TX0/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"base\"}'\ncheck \"commit v1\" '\"version\":1' \"$(call POST \"/tx/$TX0/commit\")\"\n\nsay \"long reader: pin a snapshot at v1\"\nSNAP_OUT=\"$(raw POST /snapshot)\"\necho \"$SNAP_OUT\"\nSNAP=\"$(printf '%s' \"$SNAP_OUT\" | num snapshot)\"\ncheck \"snapshot at v1\" '\"version\":1' \"$SNAP_OUT\"\n\nsay \"writers A and B both open at v1 and write k\"\nWA=\"$(begin)\"\nWB=\"$(begin)\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WA/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"A\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}'\n\nsay \"A commits first -> v2\"\ncheck \"commit v2\" '\"version\":2' \"$(call POST \"/tx/$WA/commit\")\"\n\nsay \"B commits -> expected 409 conflict\"\nCONFLICT_OUT=\"$(raw POST \"/tx/$WB/commit\")\"\nCONFLICT_STATUS=\"$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \"$BASE/tx/$WB/commit\")\"\necho \"$CONFLICT_OUT\"\ncheck \"conflict body\" 'write-write conflict' \"$CONFLICT_OUT\"\n[ \"$CONFLICT_STATUS\" = \"409\" ] && echo \"ok: HTTP 409\" || { echo \"ASSERT FAILED: status $CONFLICT_STATUS != 409\"; exit 1; }\n\nsay \"abort loser B, retry from a fresh snapshot -> v3\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB/abort\" >/dev/null\nWB2=\"$(begin)\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$WB2/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}'\ncheck \"commit v3\" '\"version\":3' \"$(call POST \"/tx/$WB2/commit\")\"\n\nsay \"pinned snapshot still reads base; latest reads B\"\nSNAP_READ=\"$(raw POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}')\"\necho \"$SNAP_READ\"\ncheck \"snapshot reads base\" '\"value\":\"base\"' \"$SNAP_READ\"\nT=\"$(begin)\"\ncheck \"latest reads B\" '\"value\":\"B\"' \"$(raw POST \"/tx/$T/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/abort\" >/dev/null\n\nsay \"GC while pinned: horizon stays 1, segments 2,3 retained\"\ncall GET /stats\nGC1=\"$(raw POST /gc)\"\necho \"$GC1\"\ncheck \"gc horizon pinned at 1\" '\"horizon\":1' \"$GC1\"\nSTATS1=\"$(raw GET /stats)\"\necho \"$STATS1\"\ncheck \"3 segments retained\" '\"segments\":3' \"$STATS1\"\nSNAP_READ2=\"$(raw POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}')\"\ncheck \"snapshot still base after gc\" '\"value\":\"base\"' \"$SNAP_READ2\"\n\nsay \"release snapshot\"\ncall POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/release\"\n\nsay \"GC after release: one base, segments removed, bytes reclaimed\"\nGC2=\"$(raw POST /gc)\"\necho \"$GC2\"\ncheck \"gc horizon advances to 3\" '\"horizon\":3' \"$GC2\"\ncheck \"files removed\" '\"files_removed\":3' \"$GC2\"\nSTATS2=\"$(raw GET /stats)\"\necho \"$STATS2\"\ncheck \"no segments remain\" '\"segments\":0' \"$STATS2\"\ncheck \"one base\" '\"bases\":1' \"$STATS2\"\n\nsay \"latest value after reclamation\"\nT=\"$(begin)\"\ncheck \"latest still B\" '\"value\":\"B\"' \"$(raw POST \"/tx/$T/get\" '{\"key\":\"k\"}')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$T/abort\" >/dev/null\n\nsay \"fault injection: arm an fsync failure; -u\n\nADDR=\"${1:-127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nBASE=\"http://$ADDR\"\nJQ=\"$(command -v jq || true)\"\n\nsay()  { printf '\\n=== %s ===\\n' \"$*\"; }\nreq()  { # method path [json-body]\n  if [ -n \"${3:-}\" ]; then\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d \"$3\" -w '\\n__status__%{http_code}'\n  else\n    curl -sS -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" -w '\\n__status__%{http_code}'\n  fi\n}\ncall() { # prints: pretty json, sets STATUS\n  local out\n  out=\"$(req \"$@\")\"\n  STATUS=\"${out##*__status__}\"\n  out=\"${out%__status__*}\"\n  if [ -n \"$JQ\" ]; then printf '%s' \"$out\" | jq . 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\\n' \"$out\"; else printf '%s\\n' \"$out\"; fi\n  printf '(http %s)\\n' \"$STATUS\"\n}\n\nsay \"health\"\ncall GET /health\n\nsay \"initial stats\"\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"writer 0: PUT k=base -> commit v1\"\nTX0=$(call POST /tx/begin | tee /dev/stderr | $JQ -r .tx 2>/dev/null || true)\n# (parsed again below in a jq-independent way)\nTX0=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST \"/tx/$TX0/put\" '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"base\"}'\ncall POST \"/tx/$TX0/commit\"\n\nsay \"long reader: pin a snapshot at v1\"\nSNAP_OUT=\"$(req POST /snapshot)\"\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$SNAP_OUT\" | \"${JQ:-cat}\" 2>/dev/null || true\nSNAP=\"$(printf '%s' \"$SNAP_OUT\" | sed 's/.*\"snapshot\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\n\nsay \"writers A and B both open at v1 and write k\"\nWA=\"$(req POST /tx/begin  | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\nWB=\"$(req POST /tx/begin  | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall POST pinned: horizon stays 1, segments 2,3 retained\"\ncall GET /stats\ncall POST /gc\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"release snapshot\"\ncall POST \"/snapshot/$SNAP/release\"\n\nsay \"GC after release: everything compacts to one base, bytes reclaimed\"\ncall POST /gc\ncall GET /stats\n\nsay \"latest value after reclamation\"\nT=\"$(req POST /tx/begin | sed 's/.*\"tx\":\\([0-9]*\\).*/\\1/')\"\ncall {"parentUuid":"01f93979-c55d-45fe-9de8-ccf45ec3a539","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_h4a2eq22sz960lhvq2sa8yz8","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp3/b/docs/requests.md","content":"# 请求样例 (Request Examples)\n\n以下样例假定服务运行在 `http://127.0.0.1:8080`，数据目录 `./data`。\n启动：\n\n```bash\ncargo run --release -- --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --data ./data\n```\n\n完整的可执行版见 [`scripts/acceptance.sh`](../scripts/acceptance.sh)。\n\n## 1. 健康检查与状态\n\n```bash\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# {\"ok\":true,\"status\":\"ok\"}\n\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/stats | jq .\n```\n\n`/stats` 字段：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `current_version` | 已提交的最新单调版本号 |\n| `base_version` | 最新压缩 base 文件覆盖到的版本 |\n| `keys` / `live_cells` | 当前键数 / 内存中保留的版本单元格数 |\n| `open_transactions` | 活跃事务及其读版本（也会钉住 GC 下界） |\n| `snapshots` | 显式快照 pin 及其版本 |\n| `files.segments/.bases/.stale` | 磁盘上各类数据文件数 |\n| `files.live_bytes/.stale_bytes` | 有效/待删除文件占用字节 |\n\n## 2. 事务：begin → put/delete/get → commit/abort\n\n```bash\n# 开启事务，返回事务 id 与固定读版本\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin\n# {\"ok\":true,\"read_version\":0,\"tx\":1}\n\n# 缓冲写\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/put \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"v1\"}'\n\n# 事务内读（读己之写；看不到其他事务的新提交）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/get \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n# {\"found\":true,\"key\":\"k\",\"ok\":true,\"value\":\"v1\"}\n\n# 删除\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/delete \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n\n# 提交：成功返回分配到的新版本\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/commit\n# {\"ok\":true,\"version\":1}\n\n# 中止（丢弃缓冲写）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/abort\n```\n\n## 3. 写写冲突（HTTP 409）\n\n两个从事务同一读版本出发、写同一键的事务，先提交者赢：\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin            # -> tx 2\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin            # -> tx 3\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/2/put -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"A\"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/3/put -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/2/commit         # ok, version:N\ncurl -s -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/3/commit\n# HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict\n# {\"error\":\"write-write conflict on key \\\"k\\\"\",\"ok\":false}\n\n# 客户端处理：abort 失败者 -> 重新 begin（拿到新读版本）-> 重放写 -> commit\n```\n\n## 4. 显式长读者快照\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot\n# {\"ok\":true,\"snapshot\":1,\"version\":1}\n\n# 即使键被后续事务覆盖/删除，快照读仍固定在 v1\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot/1/get \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n\n# 释放后快照失效（404），GC 下界随之推进\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot/1/release\n```\n\n## 5. 版本回收 / 压缩\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/gc | jq .\n# {\n#   \"base_cells\": 1,\n#   \"base_version_before\": 0,\n#   \"base_written\": true,\n#   \"bytes_reclaimed\": 180,\n#   \"files_removed\": 3,\n#   \"horizon\": 3,\n#   \"noop_reason\": null,\n#   \"ok\": true,\n#   \"stale_left\": 0\n# }\n```\n\n`horizon = min(所有活跃事务读版本, 所有显式快照版本, 当前版本)`。\n有长读者钉在旧版本时，`horizon` 不前进，`files_removed` 受其限制。\n\n## 6. 故障注入（仅用于验证同步边界）\n\n```bash\n# 下一次提交的 fsync 屏障强制失败（一次性，触发后自动解除）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"op\":\"sync\",\"leave_written\":false}'\n# op ∈ write | sync | rename | sync_parent | remove\n# leave_written=true 时先落盘/改名再报错，用于模拟“调用方未确认但已落盘”\n\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults        # 查看当前 armed 故障\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults/reset\n```\n\n预期行为：提交在故障点返回 500（`injected fault: ...`），不发布版本、\n不推进版本号、事务保持打开，可立即重试提交；重启时残留的\n`.tmp` 文件被清理。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3f1e13222b0bb47a8a3f3a23","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1712,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":89912,"output_tokens":1870,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_h4a2eq22sz960lhvq2sa8yz8":{"content":"# 请求样例 (Request Examples)\n\n以下样例假定服务运行在 `http://127.0.0.1:8080`，数据目录 `./data`。\n启动：\n\n```bash\ncargo run --release -- --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --data ./data\n```\n\n完整的可执行版见 [`scripts/acceptance.sh`](../scripts/acceptance.sh)。\n\n## 1. 健康检查与状态\n\n```bash\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# {\"ok\":true,\"status\":\"ok\"}\n\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/stats | jq .\n```\n\n`/stats` 字段：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `current_version` | 已提交的最新单调版本号 |\n| `base_version` | 最新压缩 base 文件覆盖到的版本 |\n| `keys` / `live_cells` | 当前键数 / 内存中保留的版本单元格数 |\n| `open_transactions` | 活跃事务及其读版本（也会钉住 GC 下界） |\n| `snapshots` | 显式快照 pin 及其版本 |\n| `files.segments/.bases/.stale` | 磁盘上各类数据文件数 |\n| `files.live_bytes/.stale_bytes` | 有效/待删除文件占用字节 |\n\n## 2. 事务：begin → put/delete/get → commit/abort\n\n```bash\n# 开启事务，返回事务 id 与固定读版本\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin\n# {\"ok\":true,\"read_version\":0,\"tx\":1}\n\n# 缓冲写\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/put \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"v1\"}'\n\n# 事务内读（读己之写；看不到其他事务的新提交）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/get \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n# {\"found\":true,\"key\":\"k\",\"ok\":true,\"value\":\"v1\"}\n\n# 删除\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/delete \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n\n# 提交：成功返回分配到的新版本\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/commit\n# {\"ok\":true,\"version\":1}\n\n# 中止（丢弃缓冲写）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/1/abort\n```\n\n## 3. 写写冲突（HTTP 409）\n\n两个从事务同一读版本出发、写同一键的事务，先提交者赢：\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin            # -> tx 2\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/begin            # -> tx 3\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/2/put -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"A\"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/3/put -d '{\"key\":\"k\",\"value\":\"B\"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/2/commit         # ok, version:N\ncurl -s -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/tx/3/commit\n# HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict\n# {\"error\":\"write-write conflict on key \\\"k\\\"\",\"ok\":false}\n\n# 客户端处理：abort 失败者 -> 重新 begin（拿到新读版本）-> 重放写 -> commit\n```\n\n## 4. 显式长读者快照\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot\n# {\"ok\":true,\"snapshot\":1,\"version\":1}\n\n# 即使键被后续事务覆盖/删除，快照读仍固定在 v1\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot/1/get \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"key\":\"k\"}'\n\n# 释放后快照失效（404），GC 下界随之推进\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/snapshot/1/release\n```\n\n## 5. 版本回收 / 压缩\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/gc | jq .\n# {\n#   \"base_cells\": 1,\n#   \"base_version_before\": 0,\n#   \"base_written\": true,\n#   \"bytes_reclaimed\": 180,\n#   \"files_removed\": 3,\n#   \"horizon\": 3,\n#   \"noop_reason\": null,\n#   \"ok\": true,\n#   \"stale_left\": 0\n# }\n```\n\n`horizon = min(所有活跃事务读版本, 所有显式快照版本, 当前版本)`。\n有长读者钉在旧版本时，`horizon` 不前进，`files_removed` 受其限制。\n\n## 6. 故障注入（仅用于验证同步边界）\n\n```bash\n# 下一次提交的 fsync 屏障强制失败（一次性，触发后自动解除）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults \\\n  -H 'content-type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"op\":\"sync\",\"leave_written\":false}'\n# op ∈ write | sync | rename | sync_parent | remove\n# leave_written=true 时先落盘/改名再报错，用于模拟“调用方未确认但已落盘”\n\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults        # 查看当前 armed 故障\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/faults/reset\n```\n\n预期行为：提交在故障点返回 500（`injected fault: ...`），不发布版本、\n不推进版本号、事务保持打开，可立即重试提交；重启时残留的\n`.tmp`
